keyPoints: Parimey sankhyaon ke dashamlav ya to samapt hote hain (1/4 = 0.25) ya dohraate hain (1/3 = 0.333...) — yehi unki pehchaan hai.
Aparimey sankhya (irrational) ka dashamlav na samapt hota hai na dohraata hai — √2, π iske udaharan hain.
Parimey + aparimey milkar vastavik sankhyaen (real numbers) banti hain — sankhya rekha ka har bindu koi vastavik sankhya hai.
√2 aparimey hai — ise p/q me nahi likha ja sakta; virodh se siddh hota hai ki aisa maan lena galat nikalta hai.
Karniyon ka jod-ghata same karni par hota hai: 3√2 + 5√2 = 8√2; guna me √a x √b = √(ab) — jaise √2 x √8 = √16 = 4.
Har ka parimeykaran (rationalisation): 1/√2 = √2/2 — har ko √2 se guna-bhaag karke har parimey banao — karni har me nahi rehni chahiye.
Aam galti: π ko 22/7 ke barabar samajhna — 22/7 sirf sannikat maan hai, π aparimey hai.
